description: Local UI Server Function input (FM-1; fewer manual steps design 2.2): save the display setting of a profile (showJobBrowser: start the browser of the audit, discovery, READ check and write jobs as headed). AS-b (audit send policy design 2.1): the optional audit send policy of the audit, discovery and READ check jobs (the value list is owned by src/core/audit-send-policy.ts; absent keeps the stored value). The settings are kept apart from the profile document and revision bound to the approvals (saveProfileDisplaySettings).
